state_semantics: Records with real labels. EXISTS = code/doc present; WORKING = observed running today; TESTED = automated tests on main; INTEGRATED = wired into a live surface or CI; OWNER ACCEPTED = explicit Owner statement; NOT SUPPORTED / NOT PRESENT = absent. A benchmark PASS is an observed fact about the current system (class B in the authority model); it grants no authority and is not an acceptance. Git history, results.json files and Owner decisions are authoritative over this file where they differ.
